args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. In response, we rolled back all production regions to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0. The rollback completed successfully and service health was verified post-rollback. Investigate the v2.3.1 changes before attempting a forward fix or re-deploy.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated** — checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** all production regions from v2.3.1 to **v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified recovery** — checkout-api is now healthy in all regions, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and post-rollback health.
